Carrie Leeson, who began as a volunteer, is stepping down as CEO of Lifeline Canberra. She highlighted the collective effort of volunteers and staff in reaching the milestone of one million calls answered.

Her transition highlights the value of grassroots experience in leadership, proving that those who start on the front lines often build the most resilient organizational cultures.
